sources.title: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
Quality and Methodology Information for BDUK Delivery Performance 2025/26
Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual April 2025 to March 2026
January 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
February 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
March 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
April 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
Mobile connectivity you can count on
Closure of the May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review

candidates.name: Ofcom national gigabit aggregate
candidates.gate: Exact UPRN join required before parcel promotion.

candidates.name: Decent broadband residual
candidates.gate: Satellite, affordability and technical eligibility remain separate.

candidates.name: USO affordability residual
candidates.gate: Do not equate eligibility with delivered service.

candidates.name: Local-authority file completeness
candidates.gate: All expected files and hashes required.

candidates.name: Demolished-premises discrepancy
candidates.gate: Verify current OS and contract state.

candidates.name: Annual BDUK delivery
candidates.gate: Not current service at every parcel.

candidates.name: February management snapshot
candidates.gate: Allow supplier revision and rounding tolerance.

candidates.name: March management snapshot
candidates.gate: Administrative change is not coverage loss.

candidates.name: Contracted versus built fields
candidates.gate: Never merge fields without explicit derivation.

candidates.name: Management ingestion lag
candidates.gate: Do not score milestones from snapshots.

candidates.name: Outdoor versus indoor mobile
candidates.gate: Never substitute one for the other.

candidates.name: Performance versus predicted mobile
candidates.gate: Keep separate in UI and model.

candidates.name: OMR current/planned split
candidates.gate: Never promote planned state to current.

candidates.name: Web-service outage fallback
candidates.gate: No new-source claim while live search is unavailable.

ofcom_spring_2026: National gigabit availability is an aggregate and is not exact parcel evidence.
Reported premises totals require source-date preservation.
Six-month changes are national trend indicators, not address-level proof.
Fixed and fixed-wireless residual counts must remain conceptually separated.
USO affordability and technical eligibility are separate gates.
bduk_uprn_june_2026: UPRN absence can reflect epoch differences, new builds, or filtering.
Local-authority releases require a complete file manifest before ingestion.
Demolished-premises discrepancies require current classification checks.
Exact UPRN promotion requires source hashes and a verified join.
bduk_qmi_2025_26: Official delivery statistics differ from monthly management snapshots.
Voucher methods include explicit attrition assumptions.
Estimated and directly validated premises must remain distinguishable.
Method changes must be reconciled before trend scoring.
Programme delivery is not equivalent to current service at every parcel.
bduk_bulletin_2025_26: Annual delivery totals are programme aggregates.
GIS delivery share does not establish individual parcel service.
Rural delivery share is an aggregate, not parcel truth.
Reporting periods must be preserved in downstream comparisons.
Subsidy-attributable delivery and commercial coverage are different concepts.
bduk_contracts_jan_2026: January values are rounded management data.
Initial contracted scope can change administratively.
Deferred scope is excluded from initial-scope totals.
Built totals can be affected by ingestion timing.
Monthly snapshots do not prove contractual milestone performance.
bduk_contracts_feb_2026: February values are rounded management data.
Supplier resubmissions can revise prior values.
Initial scope is not total future delivery scope.
Snapshot totals are not exact current parcel availability.
bduk_contracts_mar_2026: March values are rounded management data.
Administrative revisions must not be scored as coverage loss.
Built and contracted fields represent distinct measures.
Contract-area totals cannot be promoted to every local UPRN.
bduk_contracts_apr_2026: April values are rounded management data.
Contract-level zero-built observations require contextual review.
Initial-scope completion does not prove universal local service.
Monthly management data can lag supplier delivery.
Exact parcel promotion remains blocked without a current UPRN join.
ofcom_mobile_connectivity_2026: Mobile coverage predictions are probabilistic and device-dependent.
Outdoor coverage is not indoor coverage.
Geographic coverage is not premises coverage.
Performance measurements and predicted coverage are distinct.
Historic national values cannot establish current local service.
ofcom_srn_obligations: Future licence obligations are not current delivered coverage.
Landmass targets differ from premises and indoor coverage.
Deadline status must be verified at the relevant date.
Exact parcel claims require local coverage data and join controls.
ons_below30_jan2026: The indicator is aggregated to local-authority geography.
Confidence intervals are not supplied and must not be invented.
Aggregation can differ from other publications.
An area percentage is not an exact UPRN result.
bduk_may2026_closure: Evaluation underway is not a published current UPRN result.
Planned publication must not be treated as delivered data.
OMR supplier evidence has a defined collection vintage.
Current and planned network states must remain separate.
Future OMR cycles cannot be used as present coverage evidence.
